note: Re-captured 2026-09-12 for #86 (`->` through an undeclared one-argument template wrapper resolves on the argument class), measured against parent 769f2e8 on the same machine. An undeclared template spelling now keeps its arguments in its tag, and an arrow on it with exactly one argument naming a declared class looks the member up on that class with the usual hierarchy fan-out; a wrapper whose body is in the tree still goes through its own `operator->` (a forward declaration alone does not count as one), `.` still belongs to the wrapper, and every other shape (two arguments, a scalar, pointer or reference argument, an unknown class) stays unresolved instead of inventing a member on the wrapper. The argument is looked up the way C++ looks a name up -- through the enclosing namespaces innermost first, then the global scope, for a bare and a partially qualified spelling alike (`sptr<CameraStandard::CameraInput>` inside `namespace OHOS`), a typedef standing for the class it names, `T const` read as `T` -- but not through `using namespace` directives, because an out-of-line member definition written under one is indexed under the bare class name (hdf's hc-gen `AstObject::IsNode`) and only the bare spelling reaches those bodies. Review of the change found a second fault: a C++17 `namespace A::B {` definition was lowered as an anonymous namespace, so everything inside it registered under the bare name with internal linkage; 83 hiview files and 62 camera files open namespaces that way, and hdf none. Camera is where #86 lands: edges_direct 21059 -> 37646, edges_total 73384 -> 90933, edges_external 52214 -> 53177, arg_flow_edges 17104 -> 24482, functions_total/defined/external 25389/19016/6373 -> 24373/19020/5353. Compared by (file, line, column, caller, callee), camera gains 17739 direct edges (13528 in test and fuzzer files, 4211 in production code) and loses 1152 at 808 sites; 777 of those sites carry a replacement edge (the same call under the class's proper qualification, or the real member where an unqualified `sptr<T>` used to lower to an unknown type and `cameraInput_->Open()` bound by bare name to whatever free `Open` / `Release` / `SetCallback` / `Stop` a fuzzer defined), and the 31 left unresolved call through a wrapper whose argument class is not in the tree (`recorder_->Start()` on a media-library recorder), where the parent's edge was one of those fuzzer functions. The one indirect edge lost (109 -> 108) is the same fault at avcodec_task_manager.cpp:124, whose `->GetTimeStamp()` on a `sptr<FrameRecord>` reached a fuzzer lambda through a free function and is a direct `FrameRecord::GetTimeStamp` now. The 254 `OHOS::sptr::*` arrow phantoms are gone and a new probe pins them at 0; the constructor and `.GetRefPtr()` are wrapper operations and stay. The template-text probe drops 17 -> 7 because a wrapper member's spelling is stripped of its arguments now; those sites keep their edges. hdf moves inside its bands with every exact metric unchanged: functions_total 12638 -> 12624, functions_external 2392 -> 2378, edges_total 75680 -> 75676, edges_direct 42212 -> 42240, edges_external 28826 -> 28794, arg_flow_edges 65961 -> 65986 (its `OHOS::sptr::*` and `SharedMemQueueMeta<T>::*` phantoms become direct edges to `ServStatListenerStub::OnRemoteRequest` and `OHOS::HDI::Base::SharedMemQueueMeta::*`; no other hdf row moves). hiview moves for both faults: functions_total 11402 -> 10974, functions_defined 7779 -> 7783, functions_external 3623 -> 3191, edges_total 28633 -> 29029, edges_direct 8266 -> 8988, edges_external 20329 -> 20003, arg_flow_edges 9585 -> 9973 -- nine `OHOS::sptr::*` phantoms gone, `.` calls on unqualified `vector<T>` / `stack<T>` locals under `using namespace std` now external members on the container as their `std::`-qualified spellings always were, and 429 bare-named prototypes folding into their qualified definitions once `namespace OHOS::HiviewDFX {` reads as a scope; its 146 lost direct edges all have the same call under the proper qualification. functions_defined rises by 4 in hiview and camera because a tag keeps its arguments, so overloads that differ only inside them (`ParamValue(const std::vector<uint32_t>&)` beside `ParamValue(const std::vector<std::string>&)`) no longer fold into one definition. A tag per instantiation raises the type-table work of every header merge (camera's merged table 5408 -> 7281 entries); two output-neutral changes pay for it -- `TypeTable::intern` answers an empty named tag from the tag map instead of cloning the layout it would canonicalize into, and a unit merge remaps type ids through a dense vector instead of a hash map -- and the timing table in docs/EVAL_REPORT.md shows all three corpora level with or faster than the parent. The three hiview dispatch sites (`Plugin::OnEventProxy` line 68, `PluginProxy::OnEvent` line 28, `EventHandler::OnEventProxy` line 232) each gain one target, `TraceTestPlugin::OnEvent`, a test plugin declared inside a `namespace OHOS::HiviewDFX {` file that now joins the hierarchy under its proper name; camera's unresolved-template-text probe moves 1246 -> 1157 because 105 sites lost their template text (a wrapper member's spelling is stripped of its arguments), not because any gained an edge. Each corpus is bit-identical across three --jobs 8 runs and one --jobs 1 run. Tolerances are unchanged. Review of #86 then fixed four more faults without moving any pin outside its band: the wrapper's own name is looked up through the enclosing namespaces like its arguments (camera's `BlockingQueue<std::any>` inside `DeferredProcessing` binds to the `CameraStandard::BlockingQueue` its header includes rather than a same-named class the header never saw, so edges_direct 37647 -> 37646 and edges_total 90934 -> 90933 as a doubled `Push` overload edge becomes one), a typedef is registered under its qualified name and matched whole, an out-of-line `operator->` records its return without its class header, and `sp->f` steps through a wrapper to the pointee's field (hiview +83 field temporaries and +121 flow edges, camera +8 and +12; call edges and arg-flow counts unchanged by name). Re-captured 2026-09-10 for #83 (prototypes the C++ overload check refused to reunite with their own definitions), measured against parent 7fee472 on the same machine. Two faults: the check compared parameter types by `TypeId`, but a `.h` prototype and its `.cpp` definition arrive from two units that can intern one C type twice, so `struct HdfRemoteService *` split and every C caller of hdf's IPC interface stopped at the undefined prototype; and the candidate search consulted only `fn_by_name`, so a definition missed its declaration whenever another overload had been registered after it. Resolved pairs now compare by shape and the search scans undefined prototypes across the whole overload bucket; two DEFINITIONS still compare by id, since one qualified name legitimately carries two bodies (camera has the same class in unrelated fuzzer targets and a test mock beside the production implementation) -- without that narrowing 23 defined overload groups collapsed and `functions_defined` fell by 23. Lowering also keeps tree-sitter's `optional_parameter_declaration` nodes, registers self-typedefs (`typedef struct Foo Foo;`) and normalizes a leading `::` in type shapes, all three of which otherwise fake a mismatch between a prototype and its definition. Moved counts, all in the one direction the fix predicts -- declaration-only entities folding into their definitions and their callers' edges turning direct: hdf functions_total 12649 -> 12638, functions_external 2403 -> 2392, edges_direct 42183 -> 42212, edges_external 28854 -> 28826, arg_flow_edges 65960 -> 65961; hiview functions_total 11436 -> 11402, functions_external 3657 -> 3623, edges_direct 8204 -> 8266, edges_external 20394 -> 20329, arg_flow_edges 9517 -> 9585; camera functions_total 25613 -> 25389, functions_external 6598 -> 6373, edges_direct 20315 -> 21059, edges_external 53081 -> 52214, arg_flow_edges 17237 -> 17104. hiview moves here where it did not for the id-comparison fix alone: its 34 folded entities come from the candidate search and the default-parameter retention, not from the shape comparison. `functions_defined` is unchanged in hdf (10246) and hiview (7779) and rises by exactly one in camera (19015 -> 19016), which is a recovery rather than a duplicate: three unrelated unit-test headers under mediastream/test/unittest/filter each define their own `MockNextFilter`, two taking `(std::string name = ..., CFilterType type = ...)` and one taking `()`, and dropping the default parameters lowered the two-parameter constructors as nullary so two of the three bodies collapsed into one entry. Note that hdf's functions_defined had been pinned at 10223, which was a real measurement as of 6615690, where it summed with that revision's 2332 external to exactly the 12555 total pinned beside it; it was simply never refreshed when later PRs moved hdf's total and external pins to 12649 and 2403 (10223 + 2403 = 12626, 23 short of the total). The parent measures 10246, so the pin was stale rather than moved by this change. Tolerances are unchanged. Every exact metric (diagnostics, edges_indirect, edges_ipc, dlsym_edges, files) is identical between parent and this change in all three corpora, and each corpus was verified bit-identical across three runs at --jobs 8 and at --jobs 1 before these numbers were taken. One site check and three probes pin the fix, and all four fail on the parent binary: hdf's site check on hdf_remote_service.c:68 (1 direct target, 0 before) and the count of names carrying both a definition and a declaration-only entity (hdf exactly 0, was 10; hiview 17 +- 8, was 40; camera 40 +- 10, was 159 -- the residue is real overload sets where one member is declared and another defined, which is not the same fault). Re-verified 2026-09-07 for #57: all three corpus SQLite dumps match parent b7e070b after excluding analysis_run metadata. Refreshed 18 inherited failing expectations to those measured counts without widening tolerances; see docs/EVAL_REPORT.md. Regression expectations for scripts/eval_check.py. Each corpus pins repo + rev (commit SHA) and its checkout dir under the corpus base (~ by default, or $TRACE_CORPUS_BASE / --corpus-base); scripts/fetch_corpora.py checks the pinned revisions out and eval_check.py refuses a checkout at any other revision. 'exact' must match; 'band' compares abs(actual-expected) <= N; 'min' requires actual >= N. Site checks count distinct callee NAMES at one dispatch call_site (caller name LIKE, line). Values were re-captured 2026-09-04 on top of af26c2b (#39, the `...` punctuator fix) for the `->*` punctuator fix (#37), which moves the camera corpus by exactly one fabricated symbol and its one edge: `dps.h:40`'s `(server.get()->*func)(cmd)` used to split into `-> *`, and tree-sitter recovered `*func` as a callee, interning an external function named after the template parameter `func`. Earlier on that day the same three corpora were captured for the `...` punctuator fix (#28): the parse-diagnostic counts drop in all three corpora (27 files stop failing to parse), and the camera bulk totals move because `camera_napi_param_parser.h` now parses, so its members carry qualified names instead of the unqualified free functions the ERROR node used to leave behind. Earlier captures: 2026-09-04 on 168e643 for the gMock declaration fallbacks (#15, camera only), and 2026-09-03 on 9d15520 ('Lex C++11 raw string literals and prefixed/user-defined literals as one token', #14/#24), after the file-scoped conditional fence, `#` stringize, and preprocessor-diagnostics export fixes (#8, #13, #20) at the pinned revisions (see docs/EVAL_REPORT.md); bulk function/edge totals drift a little run-to-run (parallel index), correctness numbers do not. Re-captured 2026-09-04 on top of 9979676 (#47) for the conversion-operator fix (#46): hiview functions 11464 -> 11463 (external 3692 -> 3691) and camera 25891 -> 25884 (external 6918 -> 6911). All of it is fabricated symbols collapsing into the real ones -- an `FFI_EXPORT <type> f(...)` entry point whose attribute macro has no `#define` in the include path makes tree-sitter recover the return type and the name under a MISSING `::`, and the glued spelling was interned alongside the real symbol. Edges, defined-function counts and diagnostics do not move in any corpus, and hdf does not move at all; the new exact probes pin the malformed names at zero, since the bands are far too wide to catch a handful of symbols on their own. A second review pass then found that the same function's `<...>` stripping truncated every `operator<` / `<=` / `<<` / `<=>` to the bare keyword `operator`, collapsing a class's comparison operators into one symbol: 14 such rows across the three corpora (hdf 7, hiview 5, camera 2) become correctly-spelled members, moving hiview functions to 11465 (defined 7774) and camera to 25885 (defined 18974); hdf's row count is unchanged because the collapse renamed rather than merged there. Re-verified 2026-09-05 on top of ebb2ddb for eleven review follow-ups on #46 (conversion operators behind a leading attribute macro, in-class and out-of-class; nullary definitions behind a trailing one; members wearing an unknown macro on both sides, plain and conversion; both attribute-macro repairs missed whenever a scope nested the recovery's mark below the top `qualified_identifier`; `resolve_type_id`'s stale `Unknown` fallback; conversion targets losing the scopes and template arguments that tell two of them apart; function-pointer targets lowering as plain pointers; and standard/GNU attributes supplying the member name). Ten of the eleven do not occur in the pinned corpora and leave all three byte-identical, so they are covered by unit tests only. The eleventh does: a `[[deprecated]]` or `__attribute__((...))` parses cleanly but held an identifier in front of the declaration that the member walk took, collapsing every annotated member of a class into one symbol -- camera's `CameraInput` came down to a single `CameraInput::deprecated`. Removing 7 such phantoms (`CameraDevice`, `CameraInput`, `CameraManager`, `HCameraService`, `PhotoOutput` under `deprecated`; `SteadyClock`, `TaskManager` under a GNU `visibility`) restores 26 real members, all undefined prototypes, so camera moves 25885 -> 25904 total and 6911 -> 6930 external with functions_defined unchanged at 18974, and edges, arg-flow and diagnostics unchanged; hdf and hiview hold no attribute-named member either way and do not move. The +19 is far inside the +-120 band, so an exact probe pinning attribute-named members at zero was added to each corpus, plus one pinning `CameraInput::LockForControl` under its own name. Note that hiview's function totals reproduce as 11456/7776/3680 on some machines rather than the 11465/7774/3691 pinned here -- inside the band, stable across job counts, with files and every correctness number matching exactly. The large hdf/camera edge growth is the expansion-site LineMap attribution fix shipped with #13: call sites are deduped on (file, line, col, callee), so macro-expanded sites that used to collide on their #define coordinates are now distinct. Re-verified 2026-09-06 for #52 (empty left ## operand) against parent 240bb97 (#38, compared pre-merge as e763ff2 with an identical tree): both release builds pass 86/86 checks, all measured globals, dispatch counts and probes are identical, and all three parse-failure TSVs are byte-identical (259 files). No expectation values changed; see docs/EVAL_REPORT.md. A second review round made a field step follow its own operator, so `sp->f` on the wrapper variable itself reaches the pointee and `w.f` stays on the wrapper: hdf +34, hiview +124 and camera +985 field-step sites on direct reads through standard smart pointers, none lost, call edges unchanged by name except camera's external `::OHOS::sptr::sptr` stub now spelled `OHOS::sptr::sptr` (functions_total 24373 -> 24372, functions_external 5353 -> 5352) and 7 more camera arg-flow edges where such a read feeds a constructor argument (24482 -> 24489).
